title.en: Launch the four-choice learning navigation and safe Nearby AI classmates
title.zh: 发布四大主导航与安全的 Nearby AI 同学

purpose.en: Make SmartLingo easier to understand as Learn, Practice, Speak, Community, and Me while giving every signed-in learner an immediately available, clearly disclosed AI classmate and an optional privacy-bounded way to find real study partners.
purpose.zh: 把 SmartLingo 清晰组织为学习、练习、口语、社区和我的入口，并让每位登录学员都能立即使用明确标注的 AI 同学，同时可在隐私边界内自愿寻找真人学伴。

en: Replace the former product-link header with four stable learning choices—Learn, Practice, Speak, and Community—while the account control remains the Me destination on desktop and mobile.
Restore Community as a signed-in learning hub with Nearby, study discussions, live study meetings, colleges, rankings, and direct access to three always-available AI classmates.

Add Mika for conversation, Leo for friendly challenge practice, and Aya for real-life roleplay; every greeting, card, and response identifies the partner as AI and never presents it as a real nearby person.
Offer optional adult-only real-member Nearby matching by user-entered city or broad region, exact language pair, level, activity, and availability, with block and report controls on every result.

Explain and surface SmartLingo's two-level learning-school model: a college or school contains language departments, and each department receives administrator-created courses and the four free learning products.
zh: 把原产品链接导航改为四个稳定学习入口——学习、练习、口语和社区；桌面与移动端账户控制继续作为“我的”入口。
恢复社区为登录用户学习中心，整合 Nearby、学习讨论、实时学习会、学院、排行榜，以及三个常驻 AI 同学的直接入口。
新增会话伙伴 Mika、友好挑战伙伴 Leo 和生活角色扮演伙伴 Aya；每个问候、卡片和回复都明确标注 AI，绝不伪装成附近真人。
新增仅限成年用户自愿开启的真人 Nearby：只按用户填写的城市或大区域、精确语言组合、级别、活动和时间匹配，每张结果卡都提供屏蔽与举报。
在产品中说明并展示 SmartLingo 两层学习学校模式：学院或学校下设语言部门，每个部门自动获得管理员创建的课程与四项免费学习产品。

en: SmartLingo header navigation, Learn routing, Community, assistant personas, signed-in dashboard, My colleges explanation, D1 community schema, and the local 3 AM real-user QA plan.

The change is isolated to smartlingo.net and does not alter Clerk identity configuration, payments, supervisor prices, the 70/30 split, Cloudflare resource boundaries, sibling sites, or external-service credentials.
zh: 影响 SmartLingo 顶部导航、学习路由、社区、AI 助手角色、登录面板、我的学院说明、D1 社区结构及本机凌晨 3 点真实用户 QA 计划。
变更仅限 smartlingo.net，不修改 Clerk 身份配置、支付、主管套餐价格、70/30 分成、Cloudflare 资源边界、兄弟站点或外部服务凭据。

en: Add migration 0170 with isolated Nearby profile, block, and report tables; no latitude, longitude, address, school, workplace, email, or device-location field is stored.
Add authenticated Nearby read/save/block/report APIs with bounded input, supported-language validation, bidirectional blocking, private no-store responses, and exact language-pair matching.

Add responsive Community and dashboard modules, route-aware AI partner prompts, and a system boundary that forbids an AI classmate from claiming human identity, location, lived experience, or persistent memory.
Update the 3 AM recovery plan to verify the four-choice navigation, all six anonymous Play activities, explicit AI disclosure, and the rule that scheduled QA never enables real-member Nearby.
zh: 新增 0170 迁移，隔离存储 Nearby 资料、屏蔽和举报；不存储经纬度、地址、学校、单位、邮箱或设备定位字段。
新增需要登录的 Nearby 读取、保存、屏蔽和举报 API，包含输入长度限制、支持语言校验、双向屏蔽、private no-store 响应及精确语言组合匹配。
新增响应式社区与面板模块、按角色区分的 AI 学伴提示词，并在系统边界禁止 AI 同学声称真人身份、位置、真实经历或持久记忆。
更新凌晨 3 点恢复测试计划，验证四大导航、匿名 Play 六个入口、明确 AI 身份，以及定时 QA 绝不开启真人 Nearby 的规则。

en: All 365 repository tests pass, including Nearby privacy/safety, AI disclosure, dashboard placement, 21-day learning, 48,000 vocabulary rows, speech speed, sentence distractors, scores, rankings, courses, colleges, and Clerk boundaries.

The production vinext build, TypeScript, changed-file ESLint with zero errors, sensitive-data scan, whitespace validation, and 65-migration D1 first-run/idempotent rerun with zero foreign-key violations pass.

The isolated authenticated runtime verifies 12 protected pages and 6 APIs, and native WebKit verifies 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, Chinese and English, and five desktop, iPad, and phone viewports.
zh: 仓库 365 项测试全部通过，覆盖 Nearby 隐私与安全、AI 身份披露、面板位置、21 天学习、48,000 行词汇、语速、组句干扰词、成绩、排行榜、课程、学院及 Clerk 边界。
生产 vinext 构建、TypeScript、修改文件 ESLint 零错误、敏感信息扫描、空白校验，以及 65 个 D1 迁移的首次执行与幂等重跑均通过，外键违规为零。
隔离认证运行时验证 12 个受保护页面与 6 个 API；原生 WebKit 在 26 条路由、中英双语以及桌面、iPad、手机五种视口上完成 260/260 验证。

en: Scheduled and release QA deliberately leaves real-member Nearby disabled and does not create public location or invitation data; real matching becomes testable only after consenting adult members opt in.

The first AI-classmate release is conversation-first and reuses the audited SmartLingo assistant gateway; richer original animation and shared mission state can be added without weakening the explicit-AI boundary.
zh: 定时与发布 QA 会刻意保持真人 Nearby 关闭，不创建公开地区或邀请数据；只有成年会员主动同意并开启后，真人匹配才具备可测试数据。
首版 AI 同学以会话为主并复用已审计的 SmartLingo 助手网关；后续可增加原创动画与共同任务状态，但不会削弱明确标注 AI 的边界。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's 12 interface languages, 21-day learning paths, picture vocabulary, Today’s Sprint, SmartCard, challenge, Everyday Speaking, course progress, anonymous feature-scoped cookies, signed-in D1 progress, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery.

Competitor review informed the hierarchy of short practice, social encouragement, AI roleplay, and organization learning, but no Duolingo artwork, copy, code, user data, or proprietary curriculum was imported.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 的 12 种界面语言、21 天学习路径、图片词汇、今日速成、SmartCard、挑战、生活口语、课程进度、匿名功能级 Cookie、登录用户 D1 进度及 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布。
竞品研究仅用于理解短练习、社交鼓励、AI 角色扮演和组织学习的层级；没有导入 Duolingo 美术、文案、代码、用户数据或专有课程。
